research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Product Science is researching and developing systems and methods for analyzing software application performance, as described in 'System and method of analyzing software application performance.' The approach involves evaluating software performance by inserting trace markers into code to track when functions begin, end, and are scheduled for execution. This work focuses on improving the assessment and management of mobile app performance, reflecting the company's emphasis on performance management.

overview_description.description:
Product Science increases product metrics for mobile applications and helps apps work faster by providing insights into key performance issues that impact user experience. It analyzes the code and actual runtime data to pinpoint performance issues. Its AI enables them to do it more efficiently by providing unique insights for data visualizations to help mobile developers identify the problem right away. 

The company's integrated development environment tools and plugins display video recordings of apps alongside performance traces, providing insights into what's going on behind the screen.

Product Science was founded in 2021 and is based in Los Angeles, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Product Science is a performance management platform that helps improve mobile performance of apps.

product.name: PS Performance Regression Analysis
product.description: A tool that detects performance regressions in mobile apps by measuring real user conditions and performing statistical tests on real devices.

product.name: PS Tool
product.description: An AI-powered mobile app performance profiling tool that instruments code automatically and visualizes execution paths to identify performance bottlenecks.

product.name: CodeTuner for Mobile
product.description: A product that analyzes mobile app code to identify inefficiencies and optimize performance by correlating user flows with code execution.

product.name: CodeTuner for Cloud
product.description: A cloud cost optimization tool that analyzes server request code to identify compute, storage, and network costs within real user sessions.

product.name: Regression Analysis Platform
product.description: A platform that provides actionable insights to locate causes of performance regressions in mobile apps by measuring under real user conditions.
